# Importing standard libraries and defining data containers

import sys
from collections import deque

# Reading the data
n, k = map(int,sys.stdin.readline().split())
data = [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in sys.stdin]

# Sorting the arrays
deque(data[:k])
data.sort()

# Concatenating the arrays
result = data[:k][::-1] + data[k:][::-1]

print(*result, sep="")
